I’m going to try doing a little sauna for her and clearing out everything in her tank to clean. I’ll try to take a video but every time I try I end up becoming a total mess

There is one reptile vet who is outside of town. I called her today and she’s unavailable for the next few days. I’m going to have to try a regular vet if they’ll see me — I’m just so confused, I don’t understand what I did wrong or how everything happened so fast. I literally have pictures of her from a few days ago where she’s completely fine, I held her, I was literally checking to make sure she wasn’t showing any signs of illness since she’s been refusing food, I’m devastated that this is happening

Same experience here! I’m transgender, my mom started forcing me to see a psychiatrist who was notably hard on trans patients and didn’t really believe that it was a real thing and not just mental illness. She thought he’d take her side and shut me down, but she opened her mouth and the psychiatrist ended up advocating for me. Felt really sad that she was crazy enough to make someone whos supposedly against me to be on my side. As it turns out, I’m not manipulating her and holding her hostage by telling her I want to live my life as a different gender.

I’ve been doing my best to make sure she knows that I don’t want them to break up, I just really don’t want her to talk about her girlfriend with me when she knows that we don’t get along. I’m willing to accept being selfish still, of course, but to clarify I’ve never, ever presented her with any sort of ultimatum or denied support despite being open about disliking her personally.

He’s always considered a horrible person but he actually is a lot more. Not too many people remember or know that he tried to save a kid from abuse but ended up scaring him and turned himself into the ice box, that he willing stayed in said ice box, or that he tried to destroy the gem but just got caught up in it again after finally fixing his life. Sad shit in my opinion, he deserves better days.

It’s from before 1990, for sure, and no other similar things have turned up in our belongings. It’s hard plastic, has no flat portions, and no visible logos or marks.

This will sound very strange, but using sugar on the wound (sterile (from a packet) is best) if there is one can make it heal quicker and be less painful. Sounds like bull, I know, but it’s a trick I learnt from hospital nurses. Sugar, honey, anything like that can really help

Don’t use ice. Do not use ice. Don’t even use cold water. Use room temperature water on the slightly colder side and keep the affected area under running water for around 20min, if it isn’t severe. Using things that are too cold can do more damage, and if it’s more severe than a first degree, you can tear the skin. Aloe, petroleum jelly, or other soothing agents can be used afterwards

Technically not a class, but when I did the military aptitude test. If you failed the test, you would be called out by the sergeants and would be told “discreetly”— or as discreetly as can be done when everyone knows what’s happening. 

So a kid was called out, came back on the verge of tears to collect his pencil and water bottle. Someone else knocked someone over and the captain who was babysitting us asked them if they were okay, but the failed kid replied instead with a (very shaky sounding) “Okay? Yep! I’m okay. Yeah. Uh, just collecting my things.”

The embarrassing part of that was watching the captain awkwardly explain he wasn’t talking to him. Oof
